environment.cleanup: Task-created emulator stopped after evidence capture.

method: External instrumentation source added to the existing instrumented integration Android app; real Datadog core, Flags client, storage, and local MockWebServer HTTP intake.
observed_behavior: Requests send the configured mode and nanosecond cutoff for each subject.
Supplied valid acknowledgements install flag values in both modes.
All eight evaluations return the supplied true value.
Only telemetry-on subjects produce evaluation intake events.
Future mode preserves supplied retained allocation exposure events for both telemetry states.
Immediate mode produces no exposure for supplied non-randomized assignments.
All context callbacks execute on the dedicated background callback thread.
scope_limits: The local server supplies assignments and acknowledgement fields. This does not prove live backend allocation logic or edge/site rollout.
The bridge proxy supplies the typed telemetry control. This probe does not test OpenFeature context conversion.
The probe drains the production aggregator through its lifecycle onStop callback and explicitly flushes storage. It does not prove periodic or background scheduling.
One API 36 arm64 emulator ran. Other Android versions, physical devices, restart cache recovery, and race stress are not covered by this probe.

harness_setup_history.cause: External harness omitted SDK allowClearTextHttp for its local HTTP endpoint.
harness_setup_history.change: Enabled the same internal cleartext test helper used by existing integration tests; no production edit.
